summary: Iteration 2 (Clients hub, Reminders, Settings, Reports/BAS, PDF/Excel exports, Templates) fully validated. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests pass (11 iteration-1 regression + 21 new iteration-2). New tests cover Clients CRUD (incl. 404), client overview with paid/pending invoice grouping + totals + attached tasks, Reminders CRUD & filter, Settings default+persist, /reports/summary default FY and fy=2025 with paid income + receipt expense in the AU FY buckets (Aug income, Sep expenses, gst_payable math, months[12] with Jul..Jun labels), invoice PDF (application/pdf, %PDF magic, 404 path), /reports/pdf, and Excel exports for both invoices & receipts (openpyxl xlsx MIME + PK zip magic). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Dashboard shows Tools row with all four links (Tax Vault, Reports & BAS, Templates, Business); bottom tabs are Command/Clients/Scan/Invoices/Planner. Clients tab list + add-client modal works (created UI_Alice via API through UI). Client detail: profile card renders, editable notes saved successfully, add-reminder modal saved with local device-notification disclaimer shown, and 'new invoice for client' pre-fills client (client_name found in resulting screen). Reports screen: FY switcher (fy-prev/fy-next), income/expense chart, BAS summary block, and export-invoices/export-receipts buttons all present. Templates screen: all 3 templates present (invoice/report/expense). Settings screen loads and saves business profile via UI. No red screen, no navigation failures. Local push notifications for reminders are DEVICE-ONLY (expo-notifications, warning: 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web') and cannot be validated on the web preview — reminder is confirmed persisted via API. AI endpoints (scan-receipt GPT-4o + transcribe Whisper) still pass end-to-end.

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary dict body (id/_id are popped but other fields e.g. created_at are not protected). Consider Pydantic partial-update models.
No Pydantic validation; anything sent is stored (e.g. arbitrary keys, non-string ABN). Consider a Settings model with field types.

Uses `d.get(primary) or d.get(fallback, '')` — if primary is empty string it correctly falls through, but issue_date defaults to today when creating invoices without explicit date, so 'unpaid but issued today' will still be excluded from income (only paid); behaviour is correct but subtle.
Invalid non-24-hex id crashes with bson InvalidId → 500 (uncaught). Should wrap ObjectId() in try/except and return 400/404. (404-on-valid-but-missing id is handled correctly.)

issues: Persistent console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Carried over from iteration 1 - not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap ObjectId(id) parsing in try/except across GET/PATCH/DELETE/PDF endpoints and raise HTTPException(400) for malformed ids instead of 500.
(Optional) Add strict Pydantic partial-update models for PATCH /clients/{id}, PATCH /reminders/{id}, PATCH /tasks/{id}, PATCH /invoices/{id}/status (status enum: paid|unpaid), and PUT /settings.
(Cosmetic) Migrate deprecated RN Web props: shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents (repeated warnings on every screen).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py client_overview totals use inv.get('total', 0) — safe since Invoice model defaults total to 0.
reports_summary correctly enforces AU financial year (Jul-Jun) with month buckets and only counts paid invoices as income and all receipts as expenses.
PDF builders use ReportLab with reasonable A4 margins; invoice PDF pulls latest business settings each call.
Excel export uses openpyxl streaming to BytesIO; correct spreadsheetml MIME set.
No auth is present by design (single-user app) — endpoints are open.
